name: glitch-lens
description: Experimental glitch-token fingerprint scanner: identify which vendor family actually serves an LLM endpoint or this Codex session.

interface.shortDescription: Identify the vendor family behind an LLM endpoint or this Codex session
interface.longDescription: Probe any OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoint — or the model serving this Codex session itself — with glitch-token fingerprints covering GPT, Gemini, GLM, Qwen, kimi, Deepseek, Minimax, and Seed. Fingerprints identify known vendor-family behavior only; they cannot verify a specific model version or prove provider honesty.
